_comment: Single source of truth for the host version each MoorAI hook adapter was last verified against. Read by cli/agent-hooks/host-version.mjs (posture report: tested true|false) and scripts/host-drift.mjs (nightly drift job, .github/workflows/host-drift.yml). Bump `tested` only after the host's adapter conformance tests and smoke checks pass on that version.

claude-code.verifiedAgainst: native build 2.1.284 (hook env + input schema read from the binary, 2026-10-06)
